gates.name: lean-one-task-in-flight
gates.message: transition rejected (blocking, lean gate "one task in flight"): more than one plan row is in progress. Finish or abandon the other task, leaving at most one in-progress row, then re-attempt.

gates.name: lean-contract-only-description
gates.message: advisory (lean gate "contract is the only durable description", not enforced): types, names and signatures should carry the meaning, and a rule the type cannot express should become a precondition in the signature. Code cannot check prose restatement, so this condition never refuses a transition.

gates.name: lean-verifier-independent
gates.message: advisory (lean gate "verifier has not read the implementation", not enforced): the checking agent should work from the contract in a separate context with no shared history. Code cannot observe what a verifier read, so this condition never refuses a transition.

gates.name: lean-net-negative
gates.message: transition rejected (blocking, lean gate "change closes net-negative, or states why not"): the working change adds more lines than it removes. Remove superseded paths until the net line change is zero or negative. The predicate does not read a growth reason, so a growing change cannot pass this gate yet.

gates.name: lean-contract-recorded
gates.message: transition rejected (blocking, lean gate "contract satisfied and recorded"): a .gm/prd.yml row is still open or the worktree is not clean. Close every row and commit the change. The reason text in the commit message is not checked by code.
